verdict.rationale: Factory documents tiered autonomy that gates operations requiring manual confirmation and Missions for structured planning/orchestration of multi-feature work, implying some pre-execution checkpoint, but there is no explicit documentation of a discrete 'plan' artifact that a developer reviews and approves before any code changes run — most review evidence is post-hoc diff review after execution. Missing for 10: explicit plan-approval UI/workflow, documentation of a plan step distinct from diff review, and confirmation that autonomy tiers pause for full plan approval rather than per-action confirmation.
